criteria_outcomes.criterion: Map capabilities to needs without changing stipulated need text.
Treat supplied capabilities as stipulated inputs.

reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage produced one coverage row for each of the eight handed-off needs, preserved record_id and need text, mapped direct capability matches exactly, and left unsupported needs with empty capability_id and coverage none.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Order unsupported needs first and otherwise preserve upstream ranking.
Preserve exact evidence_sources handoff for upstream rank.

reviews.decision_reason: prioritize joined coverage to evidence_sources, marked unsupported rows correctly, used exact upstream ranks, and ordered unsupported needs first while preserving rank order within unsupported and covered groups.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Produce deterministic top-need recommendation and decision.

reviews.decision_reason: synthesize retained all eight ranked priority records and built the recommendation from the first ranked record: decision prioritize and top_need isolate faulty execution branches before replay.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Preserve record_id, need, demand_score, source_id, and source_weight fields.

reviews.decision_reason: select_demand selected all eight stipulated corpus records as the qualifying demand set, with record_id, need, demand_score, source_id, and source_weight preserved exactly.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Normalize selected evidence to required columns and bounded output.

reviews.decision_reason: normalize emitted the bounded needs table with all eight selected records and preserved the allowed corpus identifiers and required fields without changing need text or values.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Assemble ranked source provenance with deterministic ordering.

reviews.decision_reason: assemble_provenance produced eight evidence source rows with record_id, source_id, source_weight, and deterministic rank 1 through 8 matching the normalized needs order.
